root_cause.text: Unprivileged users could set Loose Source and Record Route (LSRR) and Strict Source and Record Route (SSRR) IP options without CAP_NET_RAW, enabling potential information leakage via forced routing paths.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a capability check (`ns_capable(net->user_ns, CAP_NET_RAW)`) when `opt->opt.srr` is set in `ip_options_get()`. The commit message states this restricts setting LSRR/SSRR to users with CAP_NET_RAW, and the CVE description notes that unprivileged applications could exploit these options to leak TCP ISN and other protocol information.
